official_background.source: Agriculture and Food Agency final report

limitations: SAR backscatter change can reflect moisture, irrigation, harvest, crop growth or acquisition effects.
Short-lived inundation may have receded by the post-event acquisition.
Radar observations do not establish crop damage, yield loss, financial loss or aid eligibility.
Parcel boundaries do not identify event-date crop type or provide ground truth.

radiometry.comparison: Same sensor, burst and RTC product version. Values are gamma0 power.
radiometry.stable_reference_test: Not independently established. Inspect AOI-wide shift and candidate controls before interpreting.

candidate_areas.criteria: Absolute delta >= 3 dB in VV or VH, at least 9 edge-connected pixels; exploratory only.

parcel_screening.criteria: At least 5 valid pixel centers and 80% coverage; abs(median delta) >= 3 dB in either channel. Exploratory threshold, not a damage classifier.
